subject: phase2/diagnostics/correspondence_geom/20260913T013006Z
kind: audit only; designs nothing, preregisters nothing, launches nothing

data_sources: the frozen cost-volume operator applied to random tensors

failure_mechanism.root_cause: tau is a COORDINATE CHANGE, not an experimental factor
failure_mechanism.identity: with Rf[w] = Lf[w+tau], every cell is a function of (u,d) alone, u = w+tau, d = k-tau: V_AA = Af[u+d]-Af[u], V_BB = Bf[u+d]-Bf[u], V_AB = Af[u+d]-Bf[u], V_BA = Bf[u+d]-Af[u]
failure_mechanism.symmetry_group: G = translations of the candidate axis, (k,w) -> (k-s, w+s)
residual_terms_that_break_exact_covarian: the standardisation window k in [0,12) is fixed, so in d coordinates it moves with tau
u = w+tau translates which image content the mask averages

profile_covariance.note: the units that scored h=6 are the ones MOST completely explained by the symmetry

channels.F1: candidate-axis translation covariance -- makes tracking free; only the offset c varies. THE CHANNEL THAT FIRED
channels.F2: argmin is a hard scale-free operator that reports the symmetry and nothing else
channels.F3: the gate rule is a maximum over a large null and saturates independently of F1/F2

failure_mechanism.exact_identity: h == 6  iff  (offset constant AND c == 0);  31 == 31, no exceptions

offset_provenance.conclusion: c is JOINTLY weight- and content-determined, not a pure weight property

random_lag_preference.conclusion: random weights are biased AWAY from zero lag toward d=+1; tracking is free but zero-offset is not

replacement_statistic_requirements.necessary_condition: T must NOT be invariant under the action of G on the candidate axis
replacement_statistic_requirements.R-A: must depend on the absolute candidate index, not only profile shape
replacement_statistic_requirements.R-B: must not be a function of (k_hat - tau) alone
replacement_statistic_requirements.R-C: its null must be sharpness-matched, not merely weight-randomised
replacement_statistic_requirements.R-D: it must be broken by a transformation OUTSIDE G; candidate-axis PERMUTATION is the minimal such transformation
replacement_statistic_requirements.screening_test: translate the whole profile along k by a constant and recompute; if the value does not change, the statistic is dead

identifiability.central_finding: H-a is NOT IDENTIFIABLE from a globally translated self-pair, by any statistic whatsoever. Under H-a the response peaks at d=0; under H-c/H-d it peaks at d=c. Nothing observable separates 'peaks at 0 because it matched' from 'peaks at 0 because its fixed lag response is centred'.
identifiability.scope: this is a property of the INTERVENTION, not the statistic, the mask or the gate
identifiability.H-c_vs_H-d: not separable from each other on this architecture; the distinction may not be meaningful
identifiability.retires: the entire globally-translated-self-pair experiment class, which explains the earlier geometric attempts and TR-001 landing on ceilings

observations_that_would_separate.O1: candidate-axis permutation control -- outside G, reuses the settled geometry unchanged, one extra forward pass per unit
observations_that_would_separate.O2: unmatchable regions -- breaks Rf[w]=Lf[w+tau] locally; needs a new construction and domain derivation
observations_that_would_separate.O3: non-global disparity field on real pairs with ground truth -- large, re-enters the natural-scene regime

identifiability.ceiling_even_for_O1: the trained aggregation's reported disparity depends on the candidate axis' geometric ordering, in a way a permutation-matched control with identical weights does not. Stronger than TR-001's C', weaker than correspondence.

statistic_enumeration.statistic: h = count of argmin Ibar_tau == tau

statistic_enumeration.verdict: REJECT -- equals Phi(0), constant in tau, tests nothing
REJECT as primary; admissible only as a labelled secondary descriptive

statistic_enumeration.null: DEGENERATE FOR THE WRONG REASON -- random weights fail for flatness, not blindness

statistic_enumeration.statistic: |m - tau| original vs candidate-axis-permuted, same weights
statistic_enumeration.null: the control IS the null and is sharpness-matched by construction

statistic_enumeration.statistic: per-pixel k_hat(x) vs a varying field tau(x)
statistic_enumeration.G_invariant: partly -- still admits k_hat = tau + c

measured_nulls.why_the_disparity_null_is_not_a_control: for random weights the standardised profile is flat, the softmax is near-uniform and m collapses to the window centre ~5.5 regardless of tau. The null fails for FLATNESS, not for GEOMETRIC BLINDNESS, so a merely sharper trained model would beat it while inheriting tracking for free.

pairing_audit.what_the_2x2_delivers: exact removal of every additive per-image main effect at the raw cost volume, pointwise and content-independent, valid inside the halo and the zero fill
pairing_audit.what_it_does_not_deliver: the factor it crosses with is degenerate: it contrasts matched vs crossed pairing AT A FIXED LAG COORDINATE d, and every operator has some lag at which pairing matters
pairing_audit.verdict: the pairing is sound; the factor is degenerate

cancellation_by_level.aggregation_affine_part: EXACTLY ZERO including receptive field and padding -- DERIVED; synthetic control <= 2.3e-06
cancellation_by_level.readout_z_score: NO -- and NO AFFINE CLAIM SURVIVES HERE; the z-score divides by a tau- and cell-dependent s.d.
cancellation_by_level.statistic_median: NO -- the median is not linear

pairing_audit.explicit_warning_retained: the cancellation identity licenses exactly one thing: per-image additive main effects are removed AT THE RAW COST VOLUME. It licenses nothing about the statistic, which must be calibrated empirically. GEOM-001 died from conflating these.

power_audit.gate_rule_defect: max(h_rand) over N units is a statistic of N, not of the null. P(gate passes) = (1-p)^N.
power_audit.interpretation: the null must produce a perfect unit less than once in 831 draws
power_audit.unfalsifiable_condition: if H* == 6 then min(h_trained) > 6 is impossible since h <= 6; the design cannot return a positive
power_audit.even_on_G_PASS: with H* = 5, min(h_trained) > 5 requires ALL 18 trained units to score a perfect 6
power_audit.budget_paradox: running more random seeds makes the experiment HARDER to pass
power_audit.conclusion: GEOM-002 was decided before it ran; the 241 s measured the null and decided nothing

requirements_for_a_successor_gate.P-1: null population and budget fixed before the threshold; threshold expressed as a RATE or QUANTILE, never a maximum
requirements_for_a_successor_gate.P-2: trained and null arms at the same budget per unit and over the same contexts
requirements_for_a_successor_gate.P-3: null matched on every nuisance property the statistic is sensitive to -- for m-based statistics that is SHARPNESS
requirements_for_a_successor_gate.P-4: minimum interpretable effect preregistered as a number with its justification
requirements_for_a_successor_gate.P-5: G-STOP declared on the null's RATE exceeding a preregistered ceiling, not on its maximum touching the scale top

minimum_interpretable_effect_proposed.statistic: Delta = median |m-tau|_permuted - median |m-tau|_original, paired by (checkpoint, pair, tau)
minimum_interpretable_effect_proposed.rationale: candidate quantisation is 16 px; a smaller effect is indistinguishable from readout smoothing. The second clause stops 'the control is worse' being reported as 'the model is right'.

power_audit.general_lesson: a weight-randomised null is a FLOOR, not a CONTROL. It answers 'is the effect present', never 'is the effect due to the named mechanism'. Every statistic needs both.

hard_stop_audit.gap: all eleven existing stops verify WIRING; none verifies that the statistic is CAPABLE of answering the question

HS-SYM.condition: compute the symmetry group of the intervention and verify the primary statistic is NOT invariant under it; assert numerically on random tensors with no model
HS-SYM.note: architectural availability is DERIVABLE; it should never be discovered empirically

HS-NULL-RATE.condition: the null RATE is below a preregistered ceiling, not its maximum

HS-NULL-MATCH.condition: a nuisance-matched control exists and has been measured, not only a weight-randomised floor

HS-DEGENERATE.condition: a 0/N null is verified not to be an artifact of an unrelated property

HS-CEILING.condition: the strongest supportable claim is written down before results exist and checked to be worth the compute

hard_stop_audit.retained_unchanged: HS1..HS11, all of which held in GEOM-002
hard_stop_audit.what_geom002_got_right: the gate ran FIRST, in its own process, and was terminal. The 31/576 was found before any trained number existed to be tempted by. That ordering is why this failure can be stated cleanly instead of withdrawn.

successor_feasibility.decision: JUSTIFIED, but NOT another instance of this experiment class
successor_feasibility.why_not_a_repaired_h: the distinction is NOT IDENTIFIABLE from a globally translated self-pair by any statistic; repairing h would produce a fourth geometric record with a fifth ceiling
successor_feasibility.recommended: O1 + S8 -- candidate-axis permutation control on the disparity output
why_this_one: permutation leaves the symmetry group G (R-D)
reuses the settled geometry, mask and harness unchanged
has a nuisance-matched null: same weights, same sharpness, same marginals (P-3)
was identified independently as the airtight intervention before this audit existed

conditions.C-1: the primary statistic passes HS-SYM at design time, asserted numerically before the preregistration is frozen
conditions.C-2: the null is the permutation control at equal budget, plus the random-weight floor reported separately as a floor
conditions.C-3: the minimum interpretable effect is preregistered as a number before execution
conditions.C-4: the gate is a rate/quantile rule, never a maximum
conditions.C-5: the claim ceiling is written into the preregistration and checked to be worth the compute before running
conditions.C-6: every resolution of an under-specified point is declared, as GEOM-002 did in Part B

successor_feasibility.if_conditions_cannot_be_met: stop at CORRESPONDENCE NOT DEMONSTRATED and record the synthetic-translation class as exhausted for the reason in the identifiability audit -- itself a real result and more useful than an eleventh ceiling
remaining_defects_declared_now: the same three checkpoints for the eleventh time; three seeds of one recipe; independence is gone
the designer has read the null and the mechanism; S8 was selected with that knowledge. Mitigation (derive the requirement rather than shop the null) is real but partial
the ceiling is low even for a clean S8 result
base rate: ten experiments, ten ceilings or halts, each defect found only after freezing; the last two were both derivable in advance and were not derived
chain_if_authorised: 1. SYSTEM PROMPT -- question, permutation control, statistic, ceiling; require HS-SYM and P-1..P-5
2. INDEPENDENT AUDIT -- adversarial: compute the symmetry group of the NEW intervention and prove the new statistic is not invariant under it. The step GEOM-001 and GEOM-002 both skipped
3. PREREGISTRATION -- Part A verbatim + Part B declared resolutions; HS-SYM, HS-NULL-RATE, HS-NULL-MATCH, HS-DEGENERATE, HS-CEILING + HS1..HS11
4. EXECUTION -- permutation control first, trained arm in a separate process behind the gate
